Home **/** Chandigarh **/** Accept form of transgender category candidate: HC. # Accept form of transgender category candidate: HC. Acting on a petition filed by a transgender category candidate for Constable-Executive’s post in the Chandigarh Police, the Punjab and Haryana High Court has directed the acceptance of online application form. “It is ordered that in case the petitioner submits an online application form mentioning his category as a transgender, the same shall be accepted and thereafter considered by the appropriate authority in accordance with its own rules,” asserted Justice Vikram Aggarwal of the High Court. Justice Aggarwal’s Bench, during the course of hearing, was told that the UT Administration issued an advertisement for recruitment to the post of constable (executive). The notice of motion issued by Justice Aggarwal to the respondents was accepted on the UT’s behalf by an advocate present in the court.
